summary_en: Develops an arc-shaped dual-frequency fiber ultrasound transducer array for photoacoustic computed tomography. The system combines low detection pressure, multi-octave frequency response, sheet-like focusing, whole-mouse-brain imaging to roughly 1.2 cm depth, and improved blood-oxygen-saturation mapping precision.

summary_en: Demonstrates noninvasive transcranial PACT de-aberration through ex-vivo adult human skulls using a homogeneous elastic skull model informed by adjunct anatomical imaging and fiducial registration. The reconstruction refocuses skull-distorted signals and substantially improves recovery of vascular phantoms.
